note: ARON INDEX (consistency). hit4_pct/blank_pct = share of PLAYED matches with >=4 / <=2 points, SHRUNK (K=10 towards the positional mean). aron = hit4_pct - blank_pct. A DESCRIPTION OF THE PAST, NOT A FORECAST: measured over 5 seasons, hit4 tracks points/match at r=0.90, and once you control for points AND PRICE within a position there is no lasting residual (DEF 0.12 / MID 0.13, signs flip). Compare players in the SAME POSITION at a SIMILAR PRICE.
